sizes.description: A strong fit for garage cleanouts, furniture removal, and renovation debris.
Designed for larger projects such as estate cleanouts, full-property cleanups, and heavier debris loads.

notes: A 14-day rental period is available for all containers for an additional $125 added to the base rate, if requested at the time of booking.
Dump & Return service is charged at the same rate as the initial delivery.
Rentals that extend beyond the 14th day will accrue a $25 per day fee beginning on the 15th day after delivery.
Weight over the included tonnage is charged by weight at a rate of $120 per ton.
dumpsterRental.serviceArea: Serving all of Broward and Palm Beach Counties. Miami-Dade available by appointment only — restrictions apply.

prohibitedItems.intro: The following items are not accepted in our dumpsters. If any of these materials are found in the bin, the load will be returned to your job site and a $100 surcharge will apply:
items: Appliances containing refrigerant (air conditioners, refrigerators, freezers)
